🌟 pixel2motion | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the creation of animated logos and brand motion graphics from static raster images, with outputs suitable for web and development use.
✨ Key Features: • Raster logo to SVG conversion • SVG logo animation generation • Interactive HTML motion demos • GIF/video preview exports • Motion QA evidence
📖 Summary: Pixel2Motion is an AI-powered tool that transforms raster logos into smooth, animated SVG logos. It generates interactive HTML demos, GIF/video previews, and motion QA evidence, streamlining the process of creating brand motion graphics and SVG animations.
